stated_purpose: Private messaging, end-to-end encrypted voice/video calling, and group communication.
evidence_source: Google Play Store Listing / Data Safety
policy_text:
WhatsApp Privacy Policy:

1. Location Information: We collect device location features if you use location-related features, such as when you choose to share your live location with your contacts or view nearby businesses. We do not track your real-time location when you are not using our location-related services.

2. Camera and Microphone: We access your camera and microphone only when you explicitly take photos, record audio notes, or place end-to-end encrypted audio and video calls.

3. Address Book and Contacts: If you grant permission, we access your device contacts list periodically to discover which of your contacts use WhatsApp and to facilitate messaging. We do not sell your contacts to third-party advertisers.

4. Photos and Media: We access media files strictly when you choose to upload attachments or profile pictures.

5. Device Identifiers: We collect diagnostic and performance information, including device hardware model, operating system, and connection status to maintain service reliability.
